beats.say: Virtual pop group K/DA is finally back after six long years.
Their comeback single is titled Firestarter, leading their second extended play in 2026.
Many fans assumed the original voices behind the League of Legends icons returned.
However, the line-up has changed completely for two of the four champions.
Miyeon and Soyeon return as Ahri and Akali.
Madison Beer is no longer involved, with Sophie Powers stepping in as Evelynn.
Mimi Webb also takes over from Jaira Burns as the voice of Kai'Sa.
This fresh line-up makes it feel completely new, because
